svg.title: CD4 gluten response and IEL injury are distinct components
svg.desc: MICA is a stress ligand and does not present gluten. NKG2D is not CD94/NKG2A or NKG2C, and the IEL context should not be drawn as an NK-cell-only mechanism. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.

g.inkscape:label: CD4 gluten response and IEL injury are distinct components
